scope: Candidate signed Fedora toolchain and native headers for the exact patched Tolaria source; resolve and review before installation
notes: The upstream release build uses Node 22 and pnpm 10; pnpm 10.34.9 is separately hash-pinned and passively inventoried
JavaScript and Rust dependencies remain bound by the unchanged pnpm and Cargo lockfiles and are fetched only in the disposable dependency stage
Compilation and upstream tests run later with no network, two CPUs, at most 6 GiB of memory and one Cargo job
The Tauri RPM is an intermediate source-built payload; it is never trusted as a signed Fedora package or installed through the product package database
The selected secureblue image supplies the final runtime. Loader closure and a real desktop launch must pass on that unchanged image before selection
Discovery does not install packages, fetch language dependencies, compile the application or qualify the OS
